modelAnalyticsDetailBlock.title: Model Analytics Detail
modelAnalyticsDetailBlock.description: A complete model page with provider routing, pricing, performance, uptime, benchmarks, app usage, activity, and FAQ.
modelAnalyticsDetailBlock.dataBoundaryBody: The preview ships a captured GPT-6 Astra snapshot. Consumers can replace the complete data object without changing the page composition, and the block never calls OpenRouter at runtime.
modelAnalyticsDetailBlock.compositionBody: The page uses Zeron PageLayout, Cards, Tables, Selects, Tabs, Accordion, InfoItems, MetricCards, and the shared shadcn Chart wrapper. It intentionally does not copy OpenRouter's visual styling.
modelAnalyticsDetailBlock.responsiveBody: The section sidebar becomes a horizontal sub-navigation below lg. Metrics and charts reduce to one column, while wide tables keep horizontal scrolling inside their own cards.
